chapter: Leading his own band in New York
title: Leon and Eddie's and not saving clippings
summary: He also played Leon and Eddie's; Driggs laments that he saved no write-ups and Mosley ties it to Amen.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: You know, I was at Leon's and Eddie's too on 52nd Street.
I never knew Leon and Eddie's had any jazz in there to begin with.
Leon and Eddie--I was at Leon and Eddie's before I went into the Famous Door.
I don't know why you didn't save write ups and stuff like that; boy, you're crazy. You should have really save that.
At the time you don't think that anything--
You must have been doing pretty good at that time.
I was doing very well. All I had on my mind was playing my horn; I loved to play my horn and the chicks were just eating me up.
That's why you didn't, you had your mind on the wrong thing.
That's the reason that I got messed up with "Amen" too. I'll tell you
